title: Analysis of the Quality of Emergency Physician Syndromic Classification of Psychiatric Emergency Diagnoses Compared with Inpatient Specialist Diagnoses: A Retrospective Cohort Analysis with a Historical Control Group
summary: The psychiatric emergency is a challenge for the emergency physician for several reasons. Usually only a syndromic classification of the symptoms can be made. The correct diagnosis is not always possible. In particular, complex psychiatric disorders are difficult to classify in the limited time and diagnostic framework of the emergency physician's work. Acute coronary syndrome, on the other hand, is usually easier for the emergency physician to recognize than psychiatric disorders because of its typical symptoms and ECG changes. Acute coronary syndrome is often treated in a very standardized way. However, it is unclear how good the preclinical diagnostic quality is in psychiatric emergencies and whether it differs from the supposedly easier to recognize acute coronary syndrome.
conditions: Mental and behavioural disorders due to use of alcohol
Mental and behavioural disorders due to use of sedatives or hypnotics
Mental and behavioural disorders due to use of other stimulants, including caffeine
Reaction to severe stress, and adjustment disorders

interventions.name: All prehospital emergencies with suspected psychiatric disorders during the reporting period
All emergency medical interventions with a preclinical suspicion of acute coronary syndrome and associated symptoms (NSTEMI, STEMI, angina pectoris, new-onset left bundle branch block).

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
All interventions with a suspected preclinical psychiatric diagnosis and all interventions with a suspected preclinical diagnosis of "acute coronary syndrome" and associated diseases such as NSTEMI, STEMI, acute left bundle branch block, cardiogenic shock, acute cardiac death.
Exclusion criteria:
Non-psychiatric suspected diagnosis, no suspected acute coronary syndrome and associated conditions such as NSTEMI, STEMI, acute left bundle branch block, cardiogenic shock, acute cardiac death.
